scope: Original palace conservatory exterior component study, not a new map building
original_prompt:
Make a clean high-resolution named component reference sheet, not a whole room/building. Use ONLY the one supplied source for material/motif vocabulary. Owner-requested new variations and junctions must stay coordinated with it. Separate complete objects, no fused neighbors, no cropped silhouettes, no shadows over patterns, no melting scrolls or warped rails. Straight edges/columns remain straight; thin gold stays thin. Warm-white background, even light. Print exact full ID AND short name below EVERY item, title above. One object per cell, no duplicate alternate views. Palette/style follows this source. Source illustrations are not measured models; do not invent fixed palace dimensions. No people, whole buildings, scenery, plants or loose decoration glued onto parts.
